topic: 基础综合复测与薄弱项整理
grammarFocus: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习。
title: The Community Garden Project
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。短文和问题均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。请根据短文内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
A) Last spring, a group of neighbors started a community garden on an empty lot. The lot was dirty and full of old boxes. Mr. Chen, a retired teacher, had an idea. He asked the city for permission to use the land. The city agreed, and the neighbors began to clean the area. They worked every Saturday morning for two months.

B) The garden now has ten small plots. Each family can rent one plot for a small fee. They grow vegetables like tomatoes, beans, and carrots. Mrs. Li, who lives across the street, grows the best tomatoes. She says, "I water them every evening and talk to them." Her neighbors often ask her for advice. The garden also has a shared tool shed and a compost bin.

C) The project has helped the neighborhood in many ways. Children learn how to plant seeds and care for plants. Older people meet and chat while they work. Last month, the group organized a harvest festival. Everyone brought food made from garden vegetables. More than fifty people came. The mayor visited and said, "This garden makes our city greener and friendlier."

D) Next year, the neighbors want to add a small playground for children. They also plan to build a rain barrel to save water. Mr. Chen says, "We started with nothing, but we built something beautiful together." The garden is open to everyone on weekends.

questions.prompt: What was the empty lot like before the project?
options: It was clean and ready for planting.
It was dirty and full of old boxes.
It was used as a parking lot.
answers: It was dirty and full of old boxes.
questions.explanation: 原文第一段明确说“The lot was dirty and full of old boxes.”，因此选B。
questions.evidence: The lot was dirty and full of old boxes.

questions.prompt: Who asked the city for permission to use the land?
questions.explanation: 原文第一段说“Mr. Chen, a retired teacher, had an idea. He asked the city for permission to use the land.”，所以是陈先生。
questions.evidence: He asked the city for permission to use the land.

questions.prompt: How long did the neighbors work to clean the area?
questions.explanation: 原文第一段最后一句说“They worked every Saturday morning for two months.”，因此是两个月。
questions.evidence: They worked every Saturday morning for two months.

questions.prompt: What does Mrs. Li say she does every evening?
options: She waters the plants and talks to them.
answers: She waters the plants and talks to them.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段中李太太说“I water them every evening and talk to them.”，所以选B。
questions.evidence: I water them every evening and talk to them.

questions.prompt: What did the group organize last month?
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“Last month, the group organized a harvest festival.”，因此是丰收节。
questions.evidence: Last month, the group organized a harvest festival.

questions.prompt: How many people came to the harvest festival?
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“More than fifty people came.”，所以超过五十人。

questions.prompt: What does the mayor say about the garden?
options: It is too small for the city.
It makes the city greener and friendlier.
It should be closed on weekends.
answers: It makes the city greener and friendlier.
questions.explanation: 原文第三段市长说“This garden makes our city greener and friendlier.”，因此选B。
questions.evidence: This garden makes our city greener and friendlier.

questions.prompt: What do the neighbors plan to add next year?
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说“Next year, the neighbors want to add a small playground for children.”，所以选A。
questions.evidence: Next year, the neighbors want to add a small playground for children.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: The garden also has a shared tool shed and a ______ bin.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段最后一句提到“a compost bin”，因此填compost。
questions.evidence: The garden also has a shared tool shed and a compost bin.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: They also plan to build a rain ______ to save water.
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说“They also plan to build a rain barrel to save water.”，所以填barrel。
questions.evidence: They also plan to build a rain barrel to save water.

grammar.title: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习
grammar.explanation: 本课复习一般现在时、一般过去时、一般将来时的用法；特殊疑问句的结构；可数名词与不可数名词的数量表达；以及由who, which, that引导的定语从句和because, when引导的状语从句。
grammar.example: Mrs. Li, who lives across the street, grows the best tomatoes.

options: She water the plants every evening.
She waters the plants every evening.
She watering the plants every evening.
She watered the plants every evening.
answers: She waters the plants every evening.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语是第三人称单数she，动词water要加-s，变为waters。
questions.evidence: She waters the plants every evening.

options: Where Mr. Chen asked for permission?
Where did Mr. Chen ask for permission?
Where does Mr. Chen asked for permission?
Where Mr. Chen did ask for permission?
answers: Where did Mr. Chen ask for permission?
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句结构为“疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形”，所以选B。
questions.evidence: Where did Mr. Chen ask for permission?

options: There are ten small plots in the garden.
There is ten small plots in the garden.
There have ten small plots in the garden.
There are ten small plot in the garden.
answers: There are ten small plots in the garden.
questions.explanation: plots是可数名词复数，be动词用are，且名词用复数形式plots。
questions.evidence: There are ten small plots in the garden.

options: Mrs. Li, who lives across the street, grows the best tomatoes.
Mrs. Li, which lives across the street, grows the best tomatoes.
Mrs. Li, who live across the street, grows the best tomatoes.
Mrs. Li, who lives across the street, grow the best tomatoes.
answers: Mrs. Li, who lives across the street, grows the best tomatoes.
questions.explanation: 定语从句修饰人用who，且从句谓语lives与先行词Mrs. Li一致；主句谓语grows与主语Mrs. Li一致。
questions.evidence: Mrs. Li, who lives across the street, grows the best tomatoes.
